title: Coefficient confidence for a finite family
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Its coefficient-confidence parameter is the rational number $1/(10|\mathcal F|)$, where $|\mathcal F|$ is the cardinality of $\mathcal F$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
